thread:
ben: heads-up — seeing token-stream stalls hitting gRPC deadline on us-west2 GPU pool since ~02:10 PDT. p99 token latency spikes to ~2.1s, p50 unchanged. suspect east-west packet reordering affecting streaming RPCs.

sara: any packet counters or switch alerts?

ben: opsbot posted a deploy earlier but this looks network-level. sample logs: `rpc_stream: deadline_exceeded after 2000ms send_window=64` and we see sequence numbers out of order: `seq 1023 -> 1025 -> 1024` in traces.

liam: did we change MTU or enable jumbo frames last week for batch/rdma jobs?

ben: we rolled MTU to 9000 on us-west2-c for RDMA nodes last friday. non-rdma pool was supposed to stay 1500, but some dual-homed hosts might have config drift and mixed MTU on br0/docker0.

netadmin: confirmed — leaf-sw-07 had a partial config push and an ECMP hash key change around 01:50. could cause flow spread across unequal paths and reordering.

sara: out-of-order + gRPC streaming = token gaps. short-term: can we pin routing to a single path or route streaming traffic off the affected leaf?

dina: alternatives: apply `netem reorder` as a test? or disable GRO/TSO on hosts to avoid large aggregated packets getting resegmented? which is less risky for production?

liam: disabling GRO/TSO on the host NICs reduces throughput but helps small-packet RPCs and reduces reordering side-effects for our streaming workload. It's lower blast radius than a full switch rollback.

ben: quick mitigation done on canaries: scaled down RDMA pool on us-west2-c and moved streaming traffic to us-west2-b. ran `sudo ethtool -K eth0 gro off gso off tso off` on two canary hosts. p99 dropped from ~2.1s to ~220ms on those canaries.

opsbot: incident created: #INC-3104, runbook suggested: /runbooks/network-reorder.md

netadmin: we'll rollback the partial switch push and reapply consistent ECMP hash keys. also doing a full MTU sweep (host, vSwitch, docker bridge, kube CNI).

sara: follow-ups: 1) full MTU audit across us-west2 2) add ansible guard to prevent mixed MTU config 3) add OOB sFlow metric for packet-reorder-rate 4) ship node-level option to disable GRO for streaming QoS via node selector.

ben: adding dashboard metric: `net.reorder.pct` and alert if p95 > 0.5% over 5m. will also add an evaluation comparing token gap counts pre/post.

dina: quick cost note — moving traffic across regions during mitigation can bump egress for some customers. finance FYI?

liam: I'll open a billing note, but infra fix first.

ben: plan: run 1h smoke after switch rollback + MTU fixes, then reopen RDMA nodes with consistent MTU + pinned ECMP hash. will post results in 1h.

opsbot: rollback action: `deploy-bot rollback switch-config-2026-03-17 --target leaf-sw-07` completed successfully.

ben: smoke test finished on canaries — token streams look healthy, no reorders in trace sample. scheduling full rollout tonight 03:00 UTC. will keep monitoring p99. :thumbsup:
